commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Evelyn, the Covetous ({2}{U/B}{B}{B/R} 2/5 legendary Vampire Rogue with flash; Streets of New Capenna snc, released 2022-04-29; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). Whenever Evelyn or another VAMPIRE we control enters, exile the top card of each player's library with a collection counter; once each turn we may play one such card, spending mana as any colour. Plan: a Bracket 5 cEDH turbo shell (26 lands, fast mana, free interaction) that wins with Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation/Tainted Pact, Underworld Breach + LED/Lotus Petal + Brain Freeze, or Worldgorger Dragon + Animate Dead/Dance/Necromancy (Evelyn re-entering each loop exiles four cards). Evelyn is a flash value engine and theft outlet, not the combo itself.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (cEDH). Game Changers: 19 in baseline and candidate (Ad Nauseam, Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Demonic Tutor, Force of Will, Gamble, Imperial Seal, Lion's Eye Diamond, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mystical Tutor, Necropotence, Notion Thief, Opposition Agent, Orcish Bowmasters, Rhystic Study, Thassa's Oracle, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor). Commander Spellbook find-my-combos: the same 7 complete combos in both lists (Oracle + Consultation, Oracle + Tainted Pact, Breach + Lotus Petal + Brain Freeze, Breach + LED + Brain Freeze, Worldgorger + Animate Dead / Necromancy / Dance of the Dead); almost-included 103 -> 117. No new combo is claimed. The Worldgorger loops are mandatory unless an exit exists (104.4b): another creature card in a graveyard or an instant-speed outlet; with Evelyn each iteration exiles our own top card too, so Evelyn repeats are finite.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Evelyn's Oracle: Insolent Neonate is a second Vampire (her trigger) and an instant-speed Worldgorger discard outlet; Burnt Offering converts Evelyn or Worldgorger into mana; Brainstorm and the two fetches tighten the turbo mana and selection she flashes into. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the most similar approved Grixis theft/cast-opponents'-cards decks, baseline -> candidate, canonical Archidekt exports): Don Andres, the Renegade (#14) 27 -> 29; Cormela, Glamour Thief (#9) 67 -> 69. No Gonti deck is in the Grixis registry. Marsh Flats and Verdant Catacombs are shared with Don Andres; Marsh Flats and Brainstorm with Cormela (also a cEDH shell, hence the high shared core of fast mana, free interaction and the Oracle/Consultation package). Insolent Neonate and Burnt Offering are in neither; separation is commander-first: Neonate is the only add that triggers Evelyn's Vampire clause, and Burnt Offering sacrifices Evelyn or Worldgorger for mana. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Displacer Kitten, Otawara, Morphic Pool, Talisman of Creativity, Wheel of Fortune, The One Ring, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Cyclonic Rift, Deflecting Swat, Into the Flood Maw, Hoarding Broodlord, Beseech the Mirror, the optimized-tribal Vampire top-100 package) are not re-added. No explicit owner keep is cut.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (99 rows, all 1x including the basic Island and Swamp).
Roles:
- 26 lands: Ancient Tomb, City of Traitors, Gemstone Caverns, Mistrise Village, Mount Doom, City of Brass, Mana Confluence, Command Tower, Exotic Orchard, 4 original duals, 3 shocks, 7 fetches (9 in the candidate), Island, Swamp; Thundering Falls and Blazemire Verge are cut.
- Fast mana: Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, LED, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, two Talismans, Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Culling the Weak, Rite of Flame, Simian Spirit Guide; Burnt Offering is new.
- Wins: Thassa's Oracle, Demonic Consultation, Tainted Pact, Underworld Breach, Brain Freeze, Worldgorger Dragon with Animate Dead, Dance of the Dead, Necromancy, Reanimate; Entomb, Unmarked Grave, Faithless Looting, Ripples feed the graveyard; Insolent Neonate is new.
- Tutors and draw: Demonic, Vampiric, Imperial Seal, Mystical, Gamble, Wishclaw, Praetor's Grasp, Necropotence, Ad Nauseam, Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Windfall, Final Fortune, Borne Upon a Wind, Faerie Mastermind, Gitaxian Probe; Brainstorm is new; Wan Shi Tong is cut.
- Interaction: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Pact of Negation, Mindbreak Trap, Flusterstorm, Mental Misstep, Swan Song, Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, Stifle, Chain of Vapor, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Orcish Bowmasters, Opposition Agent, Dauthi Voidwalker, Hexing Squelcher, Party Thrasher, Saw in Half, Notion Thief, Ragavan, Valley Floodcaller, Leyline of Anticipation, Defense Grid, Vexing Bauble; Spellskite and Redirect Lightning are cut.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline and candidate: 26 lands. U/B/R land sources 19/19/19 -> 20/20/19; always-tapped lands 1 -> 0 (Mistrise Village stays conditional); fetches 7 -> 9 for 8 fetch targets. Exact multivariate-hypergeometric test (conservative: lands plus rocks counted 1 each, moxen and rituals excluded): Evelyn castable by turn 4 on the play 0.1491 -> 0.1491, by turn 5 0.2767 -> 0.2768; a fetch in the first 7 cards 0.4115 -> 0.4981. Average nonland MV 1.836 -> 1.808; creatures 14 -> 13; instants/sorceries 36 -> 37.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Pact of Negation, Mindbreak Trap, Flusterstorm, Mental Misstep, Swan Song, Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, Stifle, Hexing Squelcher, Defense Grid, Leyline of Anticipation. Removal/tempo: Chain of Vapor, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Saw in Half, Orcish Bowmasters, Opposition Agent, Dauthi Voidwalker. Weak points: graveyard hate (Dauthi-style, Rest in Peace) stops Worldgorger and Breach; the redirect pair (Spellskite, Redirect Lightning) is cut, so a targeted removal on a Breach/Oracle turn is answered only by counters; Vexing Bauble counters our own free spells.

material_candidates.role: Untapped fetchland (pay 1 life, sacrifice: Plains or Swamp card onto the battlefield): finds Underground Sea, Badlands, Watery Grave, Blood Crypt or the basic Swamp.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Thundering Falls, the deck's only always-tapped land (U/R surveil 1), a 9% EDHREC cEDH inclusion. Plain owner RETAIN, not an explicit keep.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: An untapped Swamp-typed source on turn 1 for Dark Ritual into a turn-1/2 Evelyn or combo turn; every fetch shuffles Brainstorm's put-back cards away; fetching at instant speed thins before Ripples or Evelyn exile triggers.

material_candidates.reason: A tapped land in a 26-land turbo list is the clearest mana-base inefficiency; the owner retained the fetch class and density (Mistrise rationale).

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Five one-for-one swaps: two untapped fetches for the tapped/conditional lands, a Vampire combo enabler for Spellskite, Brainstorm for Redirect Lightning, and Burnt Offering for Wan Shi Tong. Losses: the redirect pair (Spellskite, Redirect Lightning) against targeted removal, Wan Shi Tong's search punishment, Thundering Falls' surveil and Blazemire Verge's Stifle-proof B. No explicit owner keep is cut.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C's exact hypothesis (+Brainstorm / -Ripples of Undeath) was run as a bounded finite test: Brainstorm is castable on turn 1 0.8385/0.8771 (play/draw) vs Ripples on turn 2 0.7852/0.8414, and Ripples bins Worldgorger only 0.0333/0.0671/0.1012 over 1/2/3 triggers on the play. But Ripples is owner-defended and its mill also fuels Breach, so the primary adds Brainstorm over Redirect Lightning instead. The exact Pass C swap and a Spell Pierce six-swap that cuts Ripples are staged as complete 100s.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Evelyn's trigger is Vampire-only and the baseline has no other Vampire, so her text fires only on her own casts. The mana base also carried one always-tapped land and one conditional dual in a 26-land turbo list, and two narrow redirect cards with almost no presence in Evelyn cEDH data.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Five swaps: Insolent Neonate adds a second Vampire trigger and a Worldgorger discard outlet; Burnt Offering (46% stats.cedh staple) sacrifices Evelyn or Worldgorger for mana; Brainstorm tests the Pass C thesis without cutting Ripples; Marsh Flats and Verdant Catacombs replace the tapped/conditional lands (81%/76% EDHREC cEDH). Spellbook complete combos unchanged (7 -> 7); Evelyn castability unchanged; fetch-in-7 0.4115 -> 0.4981.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: The five-swap floor was reached with five swaps that each stand on their own; the floor was not a target and no sixth swap cleared the bar. Every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool: eight post-floor challenges were recorded on Evelyn-specific grounds, and a six-swap package (Spell Pierce over Ripples of Undeath) is staged as a complete 100.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Spell Pierce is cheaper protection, but Ripples is the owner-defended self-mill enabler for Breach and Worldgorger.
Wan Shi Tong draws on opponents' searches, but Notion Thief turns Windfall into a one-sided wheel and the owner defended that pair.
Starting Town enters tapped after turn 3 and costs life for colour; Mount Doom is always untapped B/R.
Intuition is cheaper but the opponent chooses; Grasp takes any card from any library.
Grief is free disruption but counters itself under our Vexing Bauble; Dauthi is repeatable grave hate.
Dirge is slower sorcery-speed value; Probe is free fuel and information.
Dispel only hits instants; Squelcher protects the whole combo turn.
Final Fortune is a 66% stats.cedh staple (Ad Nauseam/LED turn extension); Gifts is too slow.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Pass C argued Ripples is slow; Spell Pierce adds a 1-mana counter for Oracle/Breach turns.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Ripples is owner-defended and the bounded test shows Brainstorm can be added without cutting it; Spell Pierce is a 10% EDHREC cEDH inclusion.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five. Each remaining weak-looking slot beats its best challenger on Evelyn-specific grounds or is owner-defended: Ripples, Vexing Bauble, Stifle, Windfall/Notion Thief and Mistrise are owner-defended (alternatives staged where a challenger was credible); Mount Doom, Praetor's Grasp, Dauthi, Gitaxian Probe, Hexing Squelcher, Final Fortune and Culling the Weak beat their challengers. Cutting more interaction would weaken the stack after the redirect pair is already gone.
